title: Track Controller Subsystem Dynamic Attributes
description: Dynamic attributes of the track controller, declaring control and speed signal wiring.

definition.description: Resource location of the subsystem model, pointing to the corresponding subsystem static attribute definition file.

control_outputs.description: Unified control signal output channel and targets. Engines, motors, gearboxes and track drives are discovered through this map.

speed_outputs.description: Vehicle forward speed output. Optional; defaults to vehicle_speed on local and global.
